'La' se un par radd kiya, phir qasam khayi aur farmaya ke ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Tere liye yahan ek martaba ladai halal hone wali hai, jis mein koi gunah aur haraj na hoga aur is mein jo mile woh halal hoga. Sirf isi waqt ke liye yeh hukm hai. Sahih hadith mein bhi hai ke is babarakat shehr Makkah ko Parwardigar-e-Alam ne awwal din se hi hurmat wala banaya hai aur Qayamat tak is ki yeh hurmat-o-izzat baqi rehne wali hai. Is ka darakht na kaata jaye, is ke kante na ukhede jayen. Mere liye bhi sirf ek din hi ki ek sa'at ke liye halal kiya gaya tha, aaj phir is ki hurmat isi tarah laut aayi jaise kal thi. Har hazir ko chahiye ke gair-hazir ko pahuncha de. Ek riwayat mein hai ke agar yahan ke jang-o-jidal ke jawaz ki daleel mein koi meri ladai pesh kare to keh dena ke Allah ne apne Rasool ko ijazat di thi aur tumhein nahin di. Phir qasam khata hai baap ki aur aulad ki. Baaz ne to kaha hai ke 'ma-walad' mein 'ma' nafiya hai, yani qasam hai us ki jo aulad wala hai aur qasam hai us ki jo be-aulad hai, yani ayal-dar aur banjh. 'Ma' ko mausoola mana jaye to ma'ni yeh hue ke baap ki aur aulad ki qasam. Baap se murad Hazrat Adam (A.S) aur aulad se murad kul insaan. Zyada qawi aur behtar baat yahi maloom hoti hai kyunke is se pehle qasam hai Makkah ki jo tamam zameen aur kul bastiyon ki maa hai, to is ke baad is ke rehne walon ki qasam khayi aur rehne walon yani insaan ke asal aur is ki jad yani Hazrat Adam (A.S) ki, phir un ki aulad ki qasam khayi. Abu Imran farmate hain murad Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) aur aap ki aulad hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain aam hai yani har baap aur har aulad. Phir farmata hai ke hum ne insaan ko bilkul durust qamat, jache-tule aaza wala, theek-thaak paida kiya hai. Is ki maa ke pet mein hi ise yeh pakeeza tarteeb aur umda tarkeeb de di jati hai, jaise farmaya: "Allazi khalaqaka fasawwaka" (82:7) yani us Allah ne tujhe paida kiya, durust kiya, theek-thaak banaya aur phir jis surat mein chaha tarkeeb di. Aur jagah hai: "Laqad khalaqnal insana fi ahsani taqwim" (95:4) hum ne insaan ko behtareen surat par banaya hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke quwwat-o-taqat wala paida kiya hai. Khud ise dekho, is ki paidaish ki taraf gaur karo, is ke danton ka nikalna dekho wagaira. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain pehle nutfa, phir khoon-e-basta, phir gosht ka lothra, garz apni paidaish mein khoob mushaqqatein bardasht ki, balkeh doodh pilane mein bhi mushaqqat aur ma'eeshat mein bhi takleef. Hazrat Qatada farmate hain sakhti aur talab-e-kasb mein paida kiya gaya hai. Ikrama farmate hain shiddat aur tool mein paida hua hai. Qatada farmate hain mushaqqat mein, yeh bhi marwi hai e'tadal aur qayam mein, duniya aur aakhirat mein sakhtiyan sehni padti hain. Hazrat Adam (A.S) chunke aasman mein paida hue the is liye yeh kaha gaya ke woh yeh samajhta hai ke us ke maal ke lene par koi qadir nahin, is par kisi ka bas nahin, kya woh na poocha jayega ke kahan se maal laya aur kahan kharch kiya? Yaqeenan is par Allah ka bas hai aur woh poori tarah is par qadir hai. Phir farmata hai ke main ne bade ware-nyare kiye, hazaron lakhon kharch kar dale. Kya woh yeh khayal karta hai ke use koi dekh nahin raha? Yani Allah ki nazron se woh apne aap ko gaib samajhta hai. Kya hum ne is insaan ko dekhne wali aankhein nahin dein? Aur dil ki baton ke izhar ke liye zaban ata nahin farmayi? Aur do hont nahin diye? Jin se kalam karne mein madad mile, khana khane mein madad mile aur chehre ki khoobsurti bhi ho aur munh ki bhi. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Ae Ibn-e-Adam! Main ne badi-badi be-had ne'matein tujh par in'aam keen jinhein tu gin bhi nahin sakta, na is ke shukr ki tujh mein taqat hai. Meri hi yeh ne'mat bhi hai ke main ne tujhe dekhne ko do aankhein dein, phir main ne un par palkon ka gilaf bana diya hai. Pas in aankhon se meri halal karda cheezein dekh, agar haram cheezein tere samne aayen to un dono ko band kar le. Main ne tujhe zaban di hai aur is ka gilaf bhi inayat farmaya hai, meri marzi ki batein zaban se nikal aur meri mana ki hui baton se zaban band kar le. Main ne tujhe sharmgah di hai aur is ka parda bhi ata farmaya hai, halal jagah to beshak istemaal kar lekin haram jagah parda daal le. Ae Ibn-e-Adam! Tu meri narazgi nahin utha sakta aur mere azab ke sehne ki taqat nahin rakhta. Phir farmaya ke hum ne use dono raste dikha diye, bhalai ka aur burai ka. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain do raste hain, phir tumhein burai ka rasta bhalai ke raste se zyada achha kyun lagta hai? Yeh hadith bahut za'eef hai. Yeh hadith mursal tareeqe se bhi marwi hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain murad is se dono doodh hain aur mufassireen ne bhi yahi kaha hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain theek qaul pehla hi hai, jaise aur jagah hai: "Inna khalaqnal insana min nutfatin..." (76:2) yani hum ne insaan ko mile-jule nutfe se paida kiya, phir hum ne use sunta dekhta kiya, hum ne is ki rehbari ki aur rasta dikha diya, pas ya to shukr-guzar hai ya nashukra.

Sadaqat aur aamal-e-saliha jahannam se nijat ke zamin hain: Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar R.A farmate hain 'Aqaba' jahannam ke ek phisalne pahar ka naam hai. Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar R.H farmate hain is ke jahannam mein sattar darje hain. Qatada R.H farmate hain ke yeh dakhle ki sakht ghati hai, is mein Allah Ta'ala ki farmanbardari se dakhil ho jao. Phir is ka dakhla bataya yeh keh kar ke tumhein kis ne bataya ke yeh ghati kya hai? To farmaya ghulam azad karna aur Allah ke naam par khana dena. Ibn-e-Zaid R.H farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke yeh nijat aur khair ki raahon mein kyun na chala? Phir hamein tanbeeh ki aur farmaya tum kya jaano 'Aqaba' kya hai? Azadgi-e-gardan ya sadaqa-e-ta'am. 'Fakka raqaba' jo izafat ke sath hai, ise 'fakka raqabatin' bhi parha gaya yani 'fakka' fa'il, dono qiraton ka matlab qareeban ek hi hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke jo kisi musalman ki gardan chhurwaye, Allah Ta'ala us ka har ek uzw us ke har uzw ke badle jahannam se azad kar deta hai, yahan tak ke hath ke badle hath, paon ke badle paon aur sharmgah ke badle sharmgah. Hazrat Ali bin Hussain R.H yani Imam Zain-ul-Abideen R.H ne jab yeh hadith suni to Saeed bin Marjana R.H (rawi-e-hadith) se poocha ke kya tum ne khud Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ki zabani yeh hadith suni hai? Aap ne farmaya haan, to aap ne apne ghulam se farmaya ke Mutarrif ko bula lo, jab woh samne aaya to aap ne farmaya jao tum Allah ke naam par azad ho. Bukhari, Muslim, Tirmidhi aur Nasai mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Sahih Muslim mein yeh bhi hai ke yeh ghulam das hazar dirham ka khareeda hua tha aur hadith mein hai ke jo musalman kisi musalman ghulam ko azad kare, Allah Ta'ala us ki ek ek haddi ke badle us ki ek ek haddi jahannam se azad kar deta hai (Ibn-e-Jarir). Musnad mein hai jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ke zikr ke liye masjid banaye, Allah Ta'ala us ke liye jannat mein ghar banata hai aur jo musalman ghulam ko azad kare, Allah Ta'ala use us ka fidiya bana deta hai aur use jahannam se azad kar deta hai. Jo shakhs Islam mein burha ho, use Qayamat ke din noor milega. Aur riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke jo shakhs Allah ki rah mein teer chalaye, khwah woh lage ya na lage, use aulad-e-Ismail A.S mein se ek ghulam ke azad karne ka sawab milega. Aur hadith mein hai jis musalman ke teen bachche balughat se pehle mar jayen, use Allah Ta'ala apne fazl-o-karam se jannat mein dakhil karega aur jo shakhs Allah ki rah mein jore (pair) de, Allah Ta'ala us ke liye jannat ke aathon darwaze khol dega, jis se chahe chala jaye. In tamam ahadith ki sanadein nihayat umda hain.

Abu Dawood mein hai ke ek martaba hum ne Hazrat Wasila bin Asqa R.A se kaha ke hamein koi aisi hadith sunaiye jis mein koi kami ziyadati na ho to aap bahut naraz hue aur farmane lage tum mein se koi padhe aur uska Quran Sharif uske ghar mein ho to kya woh kami ziyadati karta hai? Hum ne kaha Hazrat hamara matlab yeh nahin hum to yeh kehte hain ke Rasool Allah ﷺ se suni hui hadith hamein sunao, aap ne farmaya hum ek martaba Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein apne ek sathi ke bare mein hazir hue jis ne qatl ki wajah se apne upar jahannam wajib kar li thi to aap ﷺ ne farmaya is ki taraf se ghulam azad karo, Allah Ta'ala us ke ek ek uzw ke badle us ka ek ek uzw jahannam ki aag se azad kar de ga, yeh hadith Nasai Sharif mein bhi hai, aur hadith mein hai jo shakhs kisi ki gardan azad karaye Allah Ta'ala use is ka fidiya bana deta hai. Aisi aur bhi bahut si hadithein hain, Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke ek Aarabi Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas aaya aur kehne laga Huzoor ﷺ koi aisa kaam bata dijiye jis se main jannat mein ja sakun? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya thode se alfaz mein bahut sari baatein to pooch baitha. Nasma azad kar, raqbat chuda, us ne kaha Hazrat kya yeh dono ek cheez nahin? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya nahin nasma ki azadi ke ma'ani to hain akela ek ghulam azad kare aur fakk-e-raqabah ke ma'ani hain ke thodi bahut madad kare doodh wala janwar doodh peene ke liye kisi maskeen ko dena, zalim rishtedar se nek sulook karna, yeh jannat ke kaam hain, agar is ki tujhe taqat na ho to bhooke ko khila, pyase ko pila, nekiyon ka hukum kar, buraiyon se rok, agar is ki bhi taqat na ho to siwaye bhalai ke aur nek baat ke aur koi kalma zaban se na nikal. Zi masghabah ke ma'ani hain bhook wala, jabke khane ki ishtiha ho, gharz bhook ke waqt ka khilana aur woh bhi use jo nadan bacha hai sar se baap ka saya uth chuka hai aur us ka rishtedar bhi hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain maskeen ko sadqa dena ikhra sawab rakhta hai, aur rishtedar ko dena dohra ajar dilwata hai, (Musnad Ahmad) ya aise maskeen ko dena jo khak alood ho, raste mein pada hua ho ghar na ho, bistar na ho, bhook ki wajah se peeth zameen doz ho rahi ho, apne ghar se door ho, musafarat mein ho, faqeer, maskeen, mohtaj, maqrooz, muflis ho koi pursan-e-haal bhi na ho, ahl-o-ayal wala ho, yeh sab ma'ani qareeb qareeb ek hi hain, phir yeh shakhs bawajood in nek kamon ke dil mein iman rakhta ho in nekiyon par Allah se ajar ka talib ho jaise aur jagah hai Man Aradal Akhirah... jo shakhs akhirat ka irada rakhe aur is ke liye koshish kare aur ho bhi ba-iman to un ki koshish Allah ke han mashkoor hai aur jagah hai.

Man amila saliha-tan min zakarin au unsa al-ayah, iman walon mein se jo mard aurat mutabiq-e-sunnat amal kare yeh jannat mein jayenge aur wahan be-hisab roziyan payenge. Phir un ka wasf bayan ho raha hai ke logon ke sadmaat sehne aur un par raham-o-karam karne ki yeh aapas mein ek dusre ko wasiyat karte hain, jaise ke hadith mein hai: raham karne walon par Rahman bhi raham karta hai, tum zameen walon par raham karo aasmanon wala tum par raham karega. Aur hadith mein hai jo raham na kare us par raham nahin kiya jata. Abu Dawood mein hai jo hamare chhoton par raham na kare aur badon ke haq ko na samjhe woh hum mein se nahin. Aap ne farmaya haan, to aap ne apne ghulam se farmaya ke Mutarrif ko bula lo, jab woh samne aaya to aap ne farmaya jao tum Allah ke naam par azad ho. In tamam ahadith ki sanadein nihayat umda hain.

Jo shakhs Islam mein burha ho, use Qayamat ke din noor milega. Jo shakhs Islam mein burha ho, use Qayamat ke din noor milega. Aur riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke jo shakhs Allah ki rah mein teer chalaye, khwah woh lage ya na lage, use aulad-e-Ismail A.S mein se ek ghulam ke azad karne ka sawab milega. Aur hadith mein hai jis musalman ke teen bachche balughat se pehle mar jayen, use Allah Ta'ala apne fazl-o-karam se jannat mein dakhil karega aur jo shakhs Allah ki rah mein jore (pair) de, Allah Ta'ala us ke liye jannat ke aathon darwaze khol dega, jis se chahe chala jaye. In tamam ahadith ki sanadein nihayat umda hain.

Abu Dawood mein hai ke ek martaba hum ne Hazrat Wasila bin Asqa R.A se kaha ke hamein koi aisi hadith sunaiye jis mein koi kami ziyadati na ho to aap bahut naraz hue aur farmane lage tum mein se koi padhe aur uska Quran Sharif uske ghar mein ho to kya woh kami ziyadati karta hai? Hum ne kaha Hazrat hamara matlab yeh nahin hum to yeh kehte hain ke Rasool Allah ﷺ se suni hui hadith hamein sunao, aap ne farmaya hum ek martaba Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein apne ek sathi ke bare mein hazir hue jis ne qatl ki wajah se apne upar jahannam wajib kar li thi to aap ﷺ ne farmaya is ki taraf se ghulam azad karo, Allah Ta'ala us ke ek ek uzw ke badle us ka ek ek uzw jahannam ki aag se azad kar de ga, yeh hadith Nasai Sharif mein bhi hai, aur hadith mein hai jo shakhs kisi ki gardan azad karaye Allah Ta'ala use is ka fidiya bana deta hai. Aisi aur bhi bahut si hadithein hain, Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke ek Aarabi Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas aaya aur kehne laga Huzoor ﷺ koi aisa kaam bata dijiye jis se main jannat mein ja sakun? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya thode se alfaz mein bahut sari baatein to pooch baitha. Nasma azad kar, raqbat chuda, us ne kaha Hazrat kya yeh dono ek cheez nahin? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya nahin nasma ki azadi ke ma'ani to hain akela ek ghulam azad kare aur fakk-e-raqabah ke ma'ani hain ke thodi bahut madad kare doodh wala janwar doodh peene ke liye kisi maskeen ko dena, zalim rishtedar se nek sulook karna, yeh jannat ke kaam hain, agar is ki tujhe taqat na ho to bhooke ko khila, pyase ko pila, nekiyon ka hukum kar, buraiyon se rok, agar is ki bhi taqat na ho to siwaye bhalai ke aur nek baat ke aur koi kalma zaban se na nikal. Zi masghabah ke ma'ani hain bhook wala, jabke khane ki ishtiha ho, gharz bhook ke waqt ka khilana aur woh bhi use jo nadan bacha hai sar se baap ka saya uth chuka hai aur us ka rishtedar bhi hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain maskeen ko sadqa dena ikhra sawab rakhta hai, aur rishtedar ko dena dohra ajar dilwata hai, (Musnad Ahmad) ya aise maskeen ko dena jo khak alood ho, raste mein pada hua ho ghar na ho, bistar na ho, bhook ki wajah se peeth zameen doz ho rahi ho, apne ghar se door ho, musafarat mein ho, faqeer, maskeen, mohtaj, maqrooz, muflis ho koi pursan-e-haal bhi na ho, ahl-o-ayal wala ho, yeh sab ma'ani qareeb qareeb ek hi hain, phir yeh shakhs bawajood in nek kamon ke dil mein iman rakhta ho in nekiyon par Allah se ajar ka talib ho jaise aur jagah hai Man Aradal Akhirah... jo shakhs akhirat ka irada rakhe aur is ke liye koshish kare aur ho bhi ba-iman to un ki koshish Allah ke han mashkoor hai aur jagah hai.

Man amila saliha-tan min zakarin au unsa al-ayah, iman walon mein se jo mard aurat mutabiq-e-sunnat amal kare yeh jannat mein jayenge aur wahan be-hisab roziyan payenge. Phir un ka wasf bayan ho raha hai ke logon ke sadmaat sehne aur un par raham-o-karam karne ki yeh aapas mein ek dusre ko wasiyat karte hain, jaise ke hadith mein hai: raham karne walon par Rahman bhi raham karta hai, tum zameen walon par raham karo aasmanon wala tum par raham karega. Aur hadith mein hai jo raham na kare us par raham nahin kiya jata. Abu Dawood mein hai jo hamare chhoton par raham na kare aur badon ke haq ko na samjhe woh hum mein se nahin. Phir farmaya ke yeh log woh hain jin ke dahine hath mein aamal-nama diya jayega aur hamari aayaton ke jhutlane walon ke bayen hath mein aamal-nama milega, aur sar-band tah-ba-tah aag mein jayenge, jis se na kabhi chhutkara milega na nijat na rahat na aaram. Is aag ke darwaze un par band rahenge, mazeed bayan is ka Surah Wail-ul-likulli-humazatil-lumazah (Surah Al-Humazah) mein aayega Insha'Allah. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke na is mein roshni hogi na surakh hoga na kabhi wahan se nikalna milega. Hazrat Abu Imran Juwaini (R.H) farmate hain ke jab Qayamat ka din aayega Allah Ta'ala hukum dega aur har sarkash ko, har ek shaitan ko aur har us shakhs ko jis ki shararat se log duniya mein darte rehte the, lohe ki zanjeeron se mazboot bandh diya jayega, phir jahannam mein jhonk diya jayega phir jahannam band kar di jayegi. Allah ki qasam kabhi un ke qadam tikenge hi nahin, Allah ki qasam unhein kabhi aasman ki surat hi dikhayi na degi, Allah ki qasam kabhi aaram se un ki aankh lagegi hi nahin, Allah ki qasam unhein kabhi koi maze ki cheez khane peene ko milegi hi nahin (Ibn Abi Hatim). Surah Balad ki tafsir khatam hui. Falhamdulillah.
